hydration.title: React Hydration Mismatch (Server vs Client DOM)
hydration.raw_sample:
Error: Hydration failed because the initial UI does not match what was rendered on the server.
Warning: Expected server HTML to contain a matching <span> in <div>.
  at Page (app/dashboard/page.tsx:28)
  at RenderedServerComponent
hydration.root_cause: The component evaluated browser-dependent APIs (such as window.innerWidth, localStorage, or new Date()) directly during initial render. The server generated HTML with fallback content, while client hydration rendered dynamic browser values, corrupting the DOM reconciliation tree.
hydration.best_practice: Always defer browser-dependent state reads until after initial mount using useEffect or dynamic(..., { ssr: false }) in Next.js.

cors.title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Blocked
cors.raw_sample:
Access to fetch at 'https://api.backend.com/v1/users' from origin 'http://localhost:3000' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.
TypeError: Failed to fetch at fetchUsers (api.ts:18)
cors.root_cause: The browser blocked cross-origin communication because the target API server did not return the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header acknowledging origin http://localhost:3000.
cors.best_practice: For local development, configure a Vite or Next.js dev server proxy. For production, whitelist the frontend domain in backend CORS middleware headers.

typeerror.title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading .map)
typeerror.raw_sample:
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
    at ProductCatalog (ProductCatalog.jsx:14:24)
    at renderWithHooks (react-dom.development.js:15486)
typeerror.root_cause: The component evaluated products.map(...) before asynchronous network data finished loading. Because the initial state was undefined, evaluating .map threw an uncaught TypeError.
typeerror.best_practice: Always initialize collection state with an empty array ([]), and guard array methods with optional chaining (?.) and loading boundaries.

zindex.title: CSS Stacking Context Trap (Z-Index Failure)
zindex.raw_sample: CSS Bug Report: Modal overlay (.modal-backdrop) has z-index: 999999, but still renders behind adjacent card header (.profile-card) with z-index: 10.
zindex.root_cause: The modal container has an ancestor element styled with transform, filter, or opacity < 1. In CSS specifications, this forces creation of a local Stacking Context, permanently locking child z-indexes beneath sibling parent stacking contexts.
zindex.best_practice: Render floating elements (Modals, Tooltips, Dropdowns) via ReactDOM.createPortal directly on document.body to isolate them from component hierarchy stacking contexts.

loop.title: Infinite Re-render Loop (Synchronous setState in Body)
loop.raw_sample:
Error: Too many re-renders. React limits the number of renders to prevent an infinite loop.
    at checkForNestedUpdates (react-dom.development.js:27389)
    at scheduleUpdateOnFiber (react-dom.development.js:25503)
    at dispatchSetState (react-dom.development.js:17527)
    at UserProfile (UserProfile.tsx:12:5)
loop.root_cause: A state dispatch function was called synchronously within the component render function or inside a useEffect with an un-memoized object dependency that changes identity on every pass.
loop.best_practice: Never invoke state updaters synchronously in the component render body. Use derived variables or useEffect with guarded primitive dependencies.

memory_leak.title: Unmounted Component State Update (Missing useEffect Cleanup)
memory_leak.raw_sample: Warning: Can't perform a React state update on an unmounted component. This is a no-op, but it indicates a memory leak in your application. To fix, cancel all subscriptions and asynchronous tasks in a useEffect cleanup function.
memory_leak.root_cause: An asynchronous promise (like fetch or setTimeout) resolved and attempted to call setState after the user navigated away and unmounted the component.
memory_leak.best_practice: Always provide cleanup functions in useEffect or use modern AbortController signals to abort in-flight fetch requests upon component unmount.
